resources.string: This local choice controls voice replies only. It does not change the App language, text-to-speech language or system recognition provider. Opening this page does not require microphone permission.

Automatic uses the App locale, an already read Honda country of residence when available, and the provider’s ordered language candidates. A voice reply queries the provider before recording and falls back to the device default language if the query fails. Explicit choices stay independent of the country.
Initial automatic request before provider fallback: %1$s
The selection could not be saved. The previous selection remains active.
Queries the current provider without recording, requesting permission, downloading models or changing system settings. The provider may contact its own service.
The provider query timed out. Your selection has not changed.
This provider does not expose this language capability query. Your selection has not changed.
The provider rejected the capability query. This page will not request microphone permission; your selection has not changed.
Provider capabilities could not be read. Your selection has not changed.
Android 12 and earlier can only expose optional provider language details. This list does not distinguish installed models, pending downloads or online recognition.
This is the provider response for this request, not proof of actual recognition. Installed models do not force offline recognition; pending or supported models are not installed models.
Current capabilities have not been queried. Saved selection remains available.
This separate cache does not select a language or establish current availability. Re-query after changing the App locale or provider.
